newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: SBS expects NZ$7 mln March year operating profit.
newsitem.headline: SBS expects NZ$7 mln March year operating profit.

text.p: New Zealand's Southland Building Society said on Monday it expected a pre-tax operating surplus for the year to March, 1997, of NZ$7.0 million.
SBS said the unaudited draft result, while down slightly on last year's result, was ahead of budget and achieved in a tough, competitive market where margins were considerably lower than anticipated.
"The lower margins were offset by an increase in loan approvals of 47 percent over the previous year and a growth in advances of 18.8 percent to $544 million," SBS said in a statement.
Total assets were expected to exceed $646 million, an increase of 17 percent, and members' reserves would be over $40 million, up 14 percent.
